raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Since #56560, `EmulationMxfp8LinearKernel` dequantizes MXFP8 weights to BF16 once at load time, but `apply_weights` still calls `F.linear` directly. That skips the platform's unquantized-GEMM dispatch, which a BF16 checkpoint of the same layer would use.

On ROCm, that dispatch (`rocm_unquantized_gemm`) picks the skinny wvSplitK / LLMM1 kernels at decode batch sizes, while `F.linear` runs the 1-row GEMM on large hipBLASLt tiles. This PR calls `dispatch_unquantized_gemm()` instead. On CUDA and XPU the dispatcher returns `F.linear` for the default backend, so nothing changes there.

This affects every MXFP8 linear on ROCm GPUs without native MX (all but gfx95x), for example the DeepSeek-V4.1 attention and shared-expert linears.

## Duplicate-work check

- #56751 (closed) added a skinny dispatch table for DeepSeek-V4.1 on SM100 only.
- #48427 and #59782 / #60169 / #60384 / #62088 add requantized or native MXFP8 paths on CDNA; none changes the emulation path.
- #51511 proposes disabling skinny GEMM on gfx1151. The results below are on gfx1151 with skinny GEMM on, and the output matches `F.linear`.

## Test Plan

```
pytest tests/kernels/test_minimax_m3_amd_ops.py -k mxfp8_linear_emulation
```

The existing `EmulationMxfp8LinearKernel` test now also runs 1 token, which takes wvSplitK on ROCm; 7 tokens takes hipBLASLt as before.

End-to-end: `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017` on 4x Strix Halo (gfx1151), TP=4 over Ray, llama-benchy pp2048 / tg128, mirrored A B B A in one server instance.

## Test Result

```
test_minimax_m3_amd_ops.py -k mxfp8_linear_emulation   16 passed   (gfx1151)
```

| | main | this PR |
|---|--:|--:|
| decode tok/s (tg128) | 6.87 | 8.85 (+29%) |
| prefill tok/s (pp2048) | 93.5 | 93.7 |

GSM8K (first 25) with this PR: 25/25.

Per-shape latency at 1 token, weights rotated through 128 MB so each call reads from DRAM as in decode (median of 5 windows; 2 and 4 tokens are within 10%):

| linear (TP=4) | N x K | main | this PR | |
|---|---|--:|--:|--:|
| fused wq_a + wkv | 1792 x 5120 | 182 us | 83 us | 2.2x |
| wq_b | 8192 x 1280 | 117 us | 90 us | 1.3x |
| wo_a | 2048 x 4096 | 248 us | 89 us | 2.8x |
| wo_b | 5120 x 2048 | 430 us | 110 us | 3.9x |
| shared expert gate_up | 1152 x 5120 | 171 us | 55 us | 3.1x |
| shared expert down | 5120 x 576 | 38 us | 28 us | 1.4x |

AI assistance was used for this change. The submitting human has reviewed every changed line and ran the tests reported above.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""MXFP8 emulation after load-time dequantization runs the platform GEMM (on
+ROCm, the skinny wvSplitK/LLMM1 kernels at decode batch sizes)."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.mxfp8.emulation import (
+    EmulationMxfp8LinearKernel,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.mxfp8.Mxfp8LinearKernel import (
+    Mxfp8LinearLayerConfig,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.mxfp8_utils import (
+    _mxfp8_e4m3_quantize_torch,
+    dequant_mxfp8_to_bf16,
+)
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+# (N, K) of the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash MXFP8 linears at TP=4.
+V41_SHAPES = [
+    (1792, 5120),
+    (8192, 1280),
+    (2048, 4096),
+    (5120, 2048),
+    (1152, 5120),
+    (5120, 576),
+]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not current_platform.is_cuda_alike(), reason="needs a GPU")
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("n,k", V41_SHAPES)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_tokens", [1, 2, 4, 7, 32, 256])
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_mxfp8_emulation_matches_bf16_linear(monkeypatch, n, k, num_tokens):
+    """Matches F.linear on the dequantized weight at the token counts that
+    select different ROCm GEMM kernels."""
